mapper.sql: id, activity_id, sku_id, seckill_price, total_stock, available_stock, limit_per_user, status, create_time, update_time, is_deleted
mapper.insert: insert into seckill_sku ( activity_id, sku_id, seckill_price, total_stock, available_stock, limit_per_user, status, create_time, update_time, is_deleted ) values ( #{activityId}, #{skuId}, #{seckillPrice}, #{totalStock}, #{availableStock}, #{limitPerUser}, #{status}, now(), now(), 0 )
mapper.select: select from seckill_sku where id = #{id} and is_deleted = 0
select from seckill_sku where activity_id = #{activityId} and is_deleted = 0 order by sku_id
select from seckill_sku where activity_id = #{activityId} and status = 1 and is_deleted = 0 order by sku_id
select count(1) from seckill_order_request where activity_id = #{activityId} and status in (0, 1) and is_deleted = 0
